breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — Civics Unit 5: Local Self Government — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Local self-government was at its peak under the later (Imperial) Cholas of Tanjore. Lord Ripon's Resolution of 1882 gave Indians the first taste of freedom by introducing local self-government; he is the 'Father of Local Government'.

en.q: Under which Viceroy's Resolution of 1882 was modern local self-government introduced in India?

ta.q: 1882 தீர்மானத்தின் மூலம் இந்தியாவில் நவீன உள்ளாட்சியை அறிமுகப்படுத்திய வைசிராய் யார்?

questions.quote: 73rd and 74th Amendment Acts (1992): Panchayats and Municipalities as institutions of self-government; Grama Sabhas and Ward Committees; three-tier system; seats filled by direct elections; seats reserved in proportion to population; one-third seats reserved for women; uniform five-year term.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts?
options: Two-thirds of the seats reserved for women
en.explanation: One-third of the total seats are reserved for women.

ta.q: 73, 74-ஆவது அரசியலமைப்புத் திருத்தச் சட்டங்களின் சிறப்புக்கூறு அல்லாதது எது?
options: மூன்றில் இரண்டு பங்கு இடங்கள் பெண்களுக்கு ஒதுக்கீடு
ta.explanation: மொத்த இடங்களில் மூன்றில் ஒரு பங்கு பெண்களுக்கு ஒதுக்கப்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: The New Panchayati Raj System came into being in Tamil Nadu after the enactment of the new law in 1994. Salient features: three-tier system, Gram Sabha, State Election Commission, Finance Commission, reservation for SC/ST, one-third reservation for women, District Planning Committees. Village Panchayats are constituted wherever the population is above 500.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT a salient feature of the Tamil Nadu Panchayat Raj Act, 1994?
options: One-third reservation of seats for women
en.explanation: The Act provides a three-tier system.

ta.q: 1994 தமிழ்நாடு பஞ்சாயத்து ராஜ் சட்டத்தின் சிறப்புக்கூறு அல்லாதது எது?

questions.quote: Uthiramerur stone inscriptions of Paranthaka Chola I in Kanchipuram District. 'Kuda Olai Murai' was the secret ballot method. The first post-independence enactment in democratic decentralisation in Tamil Nadu was the Madras Village Panchayats Act, 1950; the Madras Panchayats Act, 1958 followed the White Paper of 1957.

en.q: The first post-independence enactment on democratic decentralisation in Tamil Nadu was the:
en.explanation: Uthiramerur inscriptions belong to the reign of Paranthaka Chola I.

ta.q: சுதந்திரத்துக்குப் பின் தமிழ்நாட்டில் மக்களாட்சி அதிகாரப் பரவலுக்கான முதல் சட்டம் எது?
ta.explanation: உத்திரமேரூர் கல்வெட்டுகள் முதலாம் பராந்தக சோழர் காலத்தவை.

questions.quote: Panchayat Union is formed by grouping of villages; members directly elected; Chairman chosen from among members. District Panchayat: one for every 50,000 people; ward members directly elected; Chairman elected from among members; term 5 years. The district collector, planning officer and concerned BDO supervise developmental functions of the Panchayat Union.

en.q: The Chairman of a Panchayat Union is:
options: chosen from among the directly elected members
en.explanation: The BDO supervises the developmental functions; he is not the Chairman.

options: நேரடியாகத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்ட உறுப்பினர்களுள் ஒருவராகத் தேர்வு செய்யப்படுபவர்
ta.explanation: வட்டார வளர்ச்சி அலுவலர் வளர்ச்சிப் பணிகளை மேற்பார்வையிடுகிறார்; தலைவர் அல்லர்.

questions.quote: Gandhi's concept of Gram Swaraj: 'India's soul lives in the village'; he dreamt of village republics in terms of Panchayat in free India; the ideal village should be self-reliant.

en.q: Which statement is attributed to Gandhi in the textbook on Gram Swaraj?
options: India's soul lives in the village
Villages are a burden on the nation
Power must remain at the centre
en.explanation: He advocated Panchayat Raj as the foundation of India's political system.

ta.q: கிராம சுயராஜ்யம் குறித்துப் பாடநூல் காந்தியுடன் தொடர்புபடுத்தும் கூற்று எது?
ta.explanation: பஞ்சாயத்து ராஜை இந்திய அரசியல் முறையின் அடித்தளமாக அவர் வலியுறுத்தினார்.

questions.quote: Town Panchayat: area with more than 10,000 people; Municipality: more than 1,00,000 people; Municipal Commissioner appointed by the government; Corporation: big cities with many lakhs of population; Mayor is the Chairman; Municipal Commissioner from the IAS. The State Election Commission conducts elections to the local governments.

en.q: According to the textbook, an area where more than 1,00,000 people live is called a:
en.explanation: A Town Panchayat has more than 10,000 people.

ta.q: பாடநூலின்படி 1,00,000-க்கும் மேல் மக்கள் வாழும் பகுதி எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்படுகிறது?

questions.quote: Important functions of the Mayor: bridge between the members of the corporation and the government; presides over the meetings of the Corporation Council; receives dignitaries from foreign countries.

en.q: Local Self Government: Which of the following is a function of the Mayor?
options: Implementing all decisions of the Council
Presiding over the meetings of the Corporation Council
en.explanation: Implementation of the Council's decisions is done by the Municipal Commissioner.
